dataset.description: Synthetic, hand-labelled change-request intents for comparing LLM-only, LLM+Verifier and LLM+Verifier+Digital-Twin configurations.
limitations: All intents and evidence are synthetic; no real user, lab device, incident or provider response is represented.
Ground truth is assigned by construction from the intent template, not by an independent human or LLM judge.
The lab has three routers and two hosts; broader topologies, routing protocols and service semantics are not covered.
The Digital Twin models structural interface reachability only; routing loops are labelled unsafe but are not detectable by that engine.
A single live model and a single recording are used; the offline results reproduce that recording, not the model's full distribution.
